releaseNotes:
Fixed: live-game web-player links are no longer listed. Every one of those pages waits for a button press (and opens an ad) before any video starts, so they could never play.

Fixed: video always uses the TV box's hardware decoder. The software decoder that took over after a few dropped frames, and made some live streams choppy, is no longer used.

Fixed: sports links from MethStreams and OnHockey that waited in the stream list for a minute or two no longer fail with a source error; they get a fresh address when picked.

More streams for every game: OnHockey links are no longer cut off by slower sources, Hoofoot is back on its new address, iStreamEast and FalconStreams follow their new addresses. Offline channels no longer raise a source error.
